mapper.select: SELECT A.AMENITY_SN, A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, A.APPLY_SCOPE_CD, A.AMENITY_NM, A.AMENITY_KEY, A.ICON_KEY, A.SORT_SEQ, A.USE_YN, A.CUSTOM_YN FROM HOUSE_AMENITY HA JOIN AMENITY_MST A ON A.AMENITY_SN = HA.AMENITY_SN AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.APPLY_SCOPE_CD IN ('HOUSE','BOTH') WHERE HA.HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND HA.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.AMENITY_CTGRY_CD, A.SORT_SEQ, A.AMENITY_SN
SELECT AMENITY_SN FROM HOUSE_AMENITY WHERE HOUSE_SN = #{houseSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
